# War Scroll Column 15 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 15 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**15:1** For this is the time of distress for Israel, and the appointed time of battle against all the nations. For the lot of God there shall be

**15:2** eternal redemption, and destruction for all the lot of Belial. There shall be great terror among

**15:3** the sons of Japheth, and Assyria shall fall with none to help. The dominion of the Kittim shall come to an end,

**15:4** that wickedness may be brought low without remnant, and there shall be no survivor among the Sons of Darkness.

**15:5** [...] The Sons of Righteousness shall shine to all the ends of the world, growing ever brighter until

**15:6** all the seasons of darkness are brought to completion. In the appointed time of God, His exalted greatness shall shine

**15:7** for all the eternal ages, bringing peace and blessing, glory and joy, and length of days for all the Sons of Light. On the day

**15:8** when the Kittim fall, there shall be a battle and terrible carnage before the God of Israel. For that is the day

**15:9** appointed by Him from of old for the war of annihilation against the Sons of Darkness. On that day the congregation of the angels

**15:10** and the assembly of mortals shall engage together in great destruction. The Sons of Light and the lot of Darkness shall do battle together

**15:11** [...] with the might of God, amid the roar of a great multitude and the battle cry of angels and men on the day of calamity.

**15:12** It shall be a time of tri[bulation for the peo]ple redeemed by God. Of all their afflictions, none shall compare to this,

**15:13** from its onset until eternal redemption is accomplished. On the day of their battle against the Kittim,

**15:14** they shall go forth to great destruction in battle. [...] Three lots the Sons of Light shall stand firm to strike down

**15:15** wickedness, and three lots Belial shall gird himself to repel the lot of [...] The infantry battalions

**15:16** shall cause the heart to melt, [...] but the might of God shall strengthen the he[art of the Sons of Light.] In the seventh lot

**15:17** the great hand of God shall subdue [Belial and all] the angels of his dominion and all the men of [his lot.]

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 15 is the exhortation before the final battle, with significant lacunae. The seven-lot battle structure (15:14-17) is the scroll's distinctive contribution: three rounds each side, with God's decisive intervention in the seventh. "Sons of Japheth" (15:2) uses Genesis 10 ethnography. The joint angelic-human warfare (15:9-11) is central to 1QM theology. "Time of distress" echoes Daniel 12:1.*
